=== solarian ===
Fees:
  Exchange listing fee: 2% (charged to the seller when posting a sell order)
  Ship listing fee: 1% (charged when listing a ship for sale on the ship exchange)
  Eviction grace: 260 missed rent cycle(s) before facility is reclaimed
Sales tax (added on top of the purchase price at buy time):
  Citizens: 1%
  Foreign citizens (default): 3% (applies when no specific treaty rate exists)
  Stateless (no citizenship): 3%
  Foreign per-empire treaty rates (MFN: lowest matching rate wins for multi-citizenship holders):
    crimson: 2%
    nebula: 2%
    outerrim: 2%
Income tax (weekly assessment on citizens' taxable earnings):
  Rate: 5%
Property tax (per-cycle tax on assessed ship value; hull + fitted modules):
  Rate: 0.50%
  Foreign-tax deduction credits (reduces this empire's income tax by taxes already paid elsewhere):
    crimson: 50% credit
    nebula: 50% credit
    outerrim: 50% credit
    voidborn: 50% credit
Station services:
  Fuel tax: 6 cr/unit surcharge on top of market price (0 = no empire fuel surcharge)
  Repair: 5 cr/hull point
Criminal law:
  Customs fine: 2.00x contraband base value (seized on inspection; fine = item value × multiplier)
  Bounty for attacking in policed space: 500cr
  Bounty for killing in policed space: 2,000cr
  Rep penalty for attack: -5 reputation
  Rep penalty for kill: -10 reputation
  Shoot-on-sight threshold: rep ≤ -20 triggers police aggression
  Detention if bounty unpaid: 24 hour(s)
  Bounty paid → rep restored: 50% of the lost rep (up to rep 10)
  Tax delinquency bounty: 100% per credit unpaid (bounty = unpaid tax × rate)
Reputation:
  Citizen baseline: 20 (reputation drifts toward this value over time for citizens)
  Outsider baseline: 10 (reputation drifts toward this value for non-citizens)
  Decay: 1 point(s) per global cycle toward baseline
  Trading rep gain: +1 rep per 200 cr of order fills, capped at +2 rep per trade
Citizenship:
  Applications: OPEN
  Application fee: 5,000cr (held in escrow; refunded on rejection or withdrawal)
  Minimum balance required: 25,000cr (in addition to the fee)
  Minimum reputation required: 40
  Auto-approve: no — qualifying applications enter the petition queue
  Starting credits for new citizens: 500cr
Contraband:
  None — no items are specifically contraband in this empire's space.
Policy last updated: unix 1778968093
